title: Shophouse bakery counter in oak and olive
summary: A long oak service counter with a fluted front and a stone-look top runs along a heritage shophouse unit. Olive wall tiles and warm pendants frame the bread display, while terrazzo-look flooring and timber shutters keep the shophouse character.
ideas: Fluted oak counter front with a rounded end
Glass bread display set into the counter run
Olive wall tiles behind the service area
Warm pendant lights over the counter
alt: Shophouse bakery-cafe with a long fluted oak counter, bread display and olive tiled wall (AI design concept)

title: Bright pharmacy-style wellness shop in light oak
summary: A pharmacy-style wellness shop with light oak gondola shelving islands, full-height oak wall shelving and a white-topped oak service counter at the back. Cream suspended panels mark zones under an even grid of downlights, with an olive feature wall and large beige floor tiles keeping the space calm and easy to browse.
ideas: Two-sided oak gondola islands with a deeper base shelf for heavier stock
Cream suspended panels above each zone for future category signs
Full-height wall shelving framing the service counter
Even downlight grid with an olive accent wall to soften the bright retail look
alt: Pharmacy-style wellness shop with light oak gondola shelving, wall shelving, a service counter and cream hanging panels (AI design concept)

title: Shophouse wine bar with oak bottle wall
summary: A warm shophouse wine bar built around a full-height light oak bottle wall with lit shelves and a hanging glass rack. A long charcoal bar top sits in front, lined with olive velvet stools on dark bases with brass footrings. Brass pendants and candles keep the lighting low, with a cream lounge corner behind.
ideas: Full-height oak bottle wall with warm under-shelf lighting
Charcoal bar top contrasting the light oak front panels
Olive velvet bar stools with brass footrings
Brass pendant lights hung low over the bar for a dim, intimate mood
alt: Shophouse wine bar with a lit light oak bottle wall, charcoal bar top, olive velvet stools and brass pendant lights (AI design concept)

title: Oak-lined car accessories showroom with olive plinths
summary: A car accessories showroom wrapped in light oak wall panels under black track lighting. Wheels and roof boxes sit on open oak shelves, a large display screen anchors the back wall, cream and olive plinths hold car care products and accessories, and a raised cream platform shows car seats beside a slatted wall of steering wheels.
ideas: Light oak wall panels with built-in open shelving for bulky items
Cream and olive plinths at different heights for product zones
Feature screen set into an oak frame on the back wall
Raised cream platform to display seats and larger accessories
alt: Car accessories showroom with light oak walls, track lighting, a wall screen, wheels and roof boxes on shelves, cream and olive product plinths and car seats on a raised platform (AI design concept)

title: Warm oak jewellery boutique with olive trays
summary: A jewellery boutique in light oak and cream. Glass-topped oak counters hold olive velvet trays of rings and bracelets, while tall glass cases show necklaces on cream busts. A seating counter with olive chairs sits at the back, under a softly lit oval ceiling cove and rows of small downlights.
ideas: Glass-topped oak counters with olive velvet trays at waist height
Tall glass display towers on oak plinths for necklaces
Back-wall showcase above a seated consultation counter
Oval ceiling cove plus small downlights to light the pieces
alt: Jewellery boutique with oak and glass display counters, olive velvet trays, glass necklace cases and a seated counter with olive chairs (AI design concept)

title: From bare office unit to business-ready workplace
summary: A before and after view of one office floor. On the left, a bare unit with a concrete floor, exposed ceiling services, a ladder and stacked timber. On the right, the finished space: carpet tiles, black-framed glass meeting rooms, a timber slat feature wall with warm strip lighting and a reception counter with a glowing base.
ideas: Black-framed glass partitions keep meeting rooms bright and open to the corridor
Vertical timber slat wall with hidden LED strip as the reception backdrop
Reception counter with a white top and warm light under the base
Black cylinder pendants and downlights for even, glare-free lighting
alt: Before and after of an office fit-out: a bare concrete unit with a ladder and timber on the left, and a finished office with glass meeting rooms, a timber slat wall and a lit reception counter on the right, with the headline From Empty Space to Business Ready and four labels: Smart Planning, Quality Workmanship, Meet Business Needs, A Better Workplace (AI design concept)

title: Warm-lit beauty retail shop with slatted timber counters
summary: A beauty and wellness shop lit in warm tones. A white-topped cashier counter with a vertical timber slat front and glowing base faces open shelving full of skincare bottles. A slatted island display sits mid-floor, black metal shelving with plants lines the right wall, and track lights run toward a full-height glass shopfront.
ideas: Vertical timber slat counter fronts with warm LED strips at the base
Backlit open shelves to make every product easy to see
Black metal shelving with hanging plants to soften a long side wall
Black track lighting leading the eye to a bright glass shopfront
alt: Beauty retail shop with a white-topped timber slat counter, backlit product shelves, a lit island display, black metal shelving with plants and a glass shopfront, with the headline Turn Your Space Into Opportunities and four labels: Custom Carpentry, Shop Renovation, Electrical & Lighting, Audio, Visual & More (AI design concept)

title: Warm timber fashion boutique with curved slat counter
summary: A fashion boutique in warm light. A curved cashier counter with vertical timber slats and a glowing base sits in front of a lit feature wall. Black metal display tables with timber tops hold folded clothes, open shelves show bags, and black track lights run across the ceiling above the clothing racks.
ideas: Curved timber slat counter with warm LED strip at the base
Black metal nesting display tables with timber tops for folded stock
Open timber shelves with backlighting for bags and accessories
Black track lighting rows to light every rack evenly
alt: Fashion boutique with a curved timber slat counter, a glowing script sign on the feature wall, black metal display tables of folded clothes, clothing racks, bag shelves, a mannequin and track lighting, with the headline Design a Shop That Sells and five key elements listed (AI design concept)
